**Install**:

```bash
yarn add --dev @wireapp/prettier-config

**Edit `package.json`**:

{

  "prettier": "@wireapp/prettier-config"
}

toolRequests.name: bash

arguments.command:
set -u
backup=$(mktemp -d)
work=$(mktemp -d)
cp -a node_modules/prettier "$backup/prettier"
restore() {
  rm -rf /app/node_modules/prettier
  cp -a "$backup/prettier" /app/node_modules/prettier
  rm -rf "$backup" "$work"
}
trap restore EXIT
cd "$work" || exit 1
packfile=$(npm pack prettier@2.0.4 --silent) || exit 1
rm -rf /app/node_modules/prettier
mkdir -p /app/node_modules/prettier
tar -xzf "$work/$packfile" -C /app/node_modules/prettier --strip-components=1 || exit 1
cd /app || exit 1
./node_modules/.bin/prettier --version || exit 1
yarn -s lint:code
code_status=$?
yarn -s lint:other
other_status=$?
exit $((code_status || other_status))

arguments.command:
set -u
backup=$(mktemp -d)
work=$(mktemp -d)
cp -a node_modules/prettier "$backup/prettier"
restore() {
  rm -rf /app/node_modules/prettier
  cp -a "$backup/prettier" /app/node_modules/prettier
  rm -rf "$backup" "$work"
}
trap restore EXIT
cd "$work" || exit 1
packfile=$(npm pack prettier@2.0.4 --silent) || exit 1
rm -rf /app/node_modules/prettier
mkdir -p /app/node_modules/prettier
tar -xzf "$work/$packfile" -C /app/node_modules/prettier --strip-components=1 || exit 1
cd /app || exit 1
./node_modules/.bin/prettier --version || exit 1
yarn -s lint:code
yarn -s lint:other
